name: Common
desc: The trade tongue of the roads, ports, and mercenary camps: everyone's second language and nobody's first.

name: Serrovine
desc: The tongue of Serrovane: precise, clause-ridden, and built for oaths that will be read back to you later.

name: Reachspeak
desc: The dock-cant of the Kestrel Reach: fast, borrowed from six directions, and rich in words for a bad deal.
